infobox.leads to: The Price of Independence, Choose Your Friends Wisely

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Discombobulate is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "I was right about Skier. He's not just trying to interrupt my work, he's trying to fucking destroy the BTR! Looks like somebody supplied him with a big load of RPG rockets. Those knuckle-dragging idiots can't even shoot it properly, but so what? With enough ammo, they'll take me down if not on the first, then on the tenth attempt. However, I might have an idea where Skier is storing these rockets. Plenty of time's passed, they've already organized their firing positions, I'm sure of it. They could be anywhere in the city, but in the forest we may be able to find all of their positions. Just follow my usual driving route and check all the places they might use to ambush me. Find the rocket crates and leave some presents for those fuckers. Let them have an explosive surprise when they come for their ammo."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Stash a VOG-25 Khattabka grenade at the first RPG ammo crate on Woods
- Stash a VOG-25 Khattabka grenade at the second RPG ammo crate on Woods
- Stash a VOG-25 Khattabka grenade at the third RPG ammo crate on Woods

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +23,400 EXP
- BTR Driver Rep +0.03
- 175,000 Roubles
- 3× Military flash drive
"Magnificent! I think I heard one explosion about 20 minutes ago already. Now this bitch Skier will think twice before threatening me."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in Raid | Notes |
| VOG-25 Khattabka improvised hand grenade | 3 | Required | N/A | Stashed item |
In this quest you have to stash 3 VOG-25 Khattabka improvised hand grenades at RPG ammo crates on Woods.

Bug: Accepting the quest and stashing the grenades in the same raid does currently not work in local PvE game mode raids.
